# W5 — Canonical guidance and final evidence

## Objective
Document the delivered typed API workflow in canonical guidance, synchronize only configured generated targets, and capture the single final full-suite evidence set after W1–W4.

## Requirements and design
- Canonical owner: `.agents/instructions/workflow/mission-tooling.instructions.md`; align its linked `workflow-tools/.agents/instructions/workflow/roadmap-authoring.instructions.md` and `workflow-tools/mission/README.md` only where the delivered contract differs.
- Cover API-managed inline input, schema-v2 source/Part refs, draft save versus publish readiness, structured diagnostics, serial derivation, append-only migration/recovery, and explicit roots/cwd.
- Before generated changes, inspect configuration and run `cargo run -p rule --features cli --bin rule -- explain-target --config <resolved-config> --target <resolved-id>` from `/home/linus/git/meta-workspace/workflow-tools`. If configured, run `sync-targets --config <resolved-config>` then the same with `--check`; otherwise record the no-target readback and run applicable canonical Markdown/link checks. Never hand-edit generated targets.

## Examples
Guidance shows an incomplete draft saving but publish rejecting blank required waypoint fields; it directs migration operators to plan/read/recovery and records roots. A configured target synchronizes and passes its check; an absent target is evidenced rather than invented.

## Validation
After all code is complete, run once each final gate: `cargo fmt --check --all`; `cargo check --workspace --all-targets --features cli,mcp`; `cargo test -p mission-api`; and `cargo test -p mission --features cli,mcp`. Do not rerun unchanged intermediate full suites.

## Non-goals and handoff
No installer/test-tool/security expansion, Mission mutation, or commit during planning. Execution checkpoint: `docs(mission): document typed authoring`.

# Requirements — canonical guidance and final evidence

Implement W5 after W3 and W4. Update canonical Markdown owners only: mission-tooling instructions, linked roadmap-authoring instructions where the published contract changes, and the Mission README. Planning found no applicable targets in canonical roots: do not perform unresolved configuration discovery, invent a generator, or hand-edit generated output.

Run the exact read-only guidance gates once: `audit hook /home/linus/git/meta-workspace` and `audit hook /home/linus/git/meta-workspace/workflow-tools`; neither is autofix. From `/home/linus/git/meta-workspace/workflow-tools/mission`, run the final evidence set once after W1–W4: `cargo fmt --check -p mission -p mission-api`; `cargo check -p mission --all-targets --features cli,mcp`; `cargo test -p mission-api`; `cargo test -p mission --features cli,mcp`. Do not run full-workspace checks or repeat unchanged suites.

Intermediate focused evidence is owned by W1–W4; retain it rather than duplicate it. Checkpoint: `docs(mission): document typed authoring`. No installer/test-tool/security expansion or Mission mutation during planning.
